source_candidates.name: Diretta/Flashscore GoldBet TRUE OPEN index
quality_notes: Every diretta_current observation is before kickoff, but the median lead time is 958.76 minutes and the range is 5.85-1,401.06 minutes.
diretta_current is a single observed price and is not certified as the last pre-kickoff close.
home_score, away_score and match_score are fuzzy identity confidence values, not final outcomes.
608 primary 1X2/FT Over rows show an active absolute drop >=0.20 across 342 events; they remain diagnostic until close and outcome joins exist.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet movement-state exact outcome T-30 pilot

No post-kickoff snapshot is used.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet TRUE OPEN exact-outcome calibration 2026
quality_notes: All pre-match price rows are frozen before final outcomes are attached.
Four event feeds lack both regular-half score sections and remain excluded.
Observed-current timing is heterogeneous and never relabelled CLOSE.
Fixture-clustered paired intervals cross zero for aggregate and each market-specific current-versus-open comparison.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet fixture-level MMS exact-outcome diagnostic
quality_notes: At most one maximum-shortening selection is retained per fixture and market; O/U is restricted to line 2.5.
All price features are frozen before exact-ID outcomes are attached.
Every 10,000-draw ROI interval includes zero.
O/U 2.5 and BTTS have negative point ROI at all 1/2/3pp thresholds.
Observed-current timing is heterogeneous and remains distinct from CLOSE.

goldbet_2026_exact_outcomes.rule: Exact Flashscore event ID only; require both regular halves; never use fuzzy match-score fields.

same_book_open_close.note: Fixture-level testing covers 638 exact outcomes and 1,897 pre-specified market units. All 1/2/3pp and absolute-drop 0.20 ROI intervals include zero; no MMS threshold is promoted. Observed-current remains non-CLOSE.

market_close_benchmark.rule: Benchmark market closing prices may support CLV/context only under their true bookmaker/source labels; they never substitute GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

intermediate_t30.rule: Never derive T-30 from CLOSE or interpolate absent timestamps. Preserve checkpoint distance and GOOD/FALLBACK quality.

pre_match_structural.anti_leakage: Features use strictly prior source dates; updates occur only after the complete date batch.
pre_match_structural.result: Elo beats the development prior in Sweden, Norway and Netherlands, but not robustly in Denmark. Form/full bundles remain unpromoted in every league; external close remains non-GoldBet.
pre_match_structural.identity_gate: League-format integrity required before metrics: 16 teams/240 matches for Sweden-Norway; 12 teams/32 matches per club for Denmark; 18 teams/34 matches per club for Netherlands.

quarantine_rules: prospective 2026 snapshots are not multi-season historical evidence
FIRST_SEEN cannot substitute TRUE OPEN in primary MMS tests
non-GoldBet bookmaker odds cannot be relabelled GoldBet
single-fixture proofs cannot support threshold promotion
sources without unambiguous fixture identity or timestamps are excluded
post-kickoff facts are outcome/evaluation data only

acceptance_gate.structural_rule: Only prior source dates may enter rolling features because source timezone is not documented.
acceptance_gate.market_rule: AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA are closing odds under the provider's documented C-column semantics; retain external benchmark class.
acceptance_gate.primary_mms_reason: Certified GoldBet TRUE OPEN exists and may generate MMS signals. Historical ROI/CLV promotion still requires observed close and outcome joins.

next_source_block.goal: Materialize separately sourced final outcomes for exact Flashscore event IDs and identify a provable last GoldBet pre-kickoff snapshot without relabelling the existing single current observation as CLOSE.
next_source_block.prior_claim_status: TRUE OPEN and exact observed current verified for all 642 events; 608 primary drops across 342 events.
next_source_block.structural_next: Hold all four league OOS blocks frozen.
